reviewMethod: Codex drafting followed by a separate agent editorial review against complete archived source; not independent legal review.

headings.title: Depositing, holding, and transferring securities
headings.reviewNote: Read all authorizations, ownership records, book-entry transfers, regulatory conditions, certifications on demand, scope and clearing-corporation definition; title describes broad activities without extending eligibility.

headings.title: Safekeeping and verification of state deposit collateral
headings.reviewNote: Addresses bonds securing state-treasurer deposits, permissible custody methods and agreed verification procedures, rather than general private collateral.

headings.title: Insurance securities deposits and withdrawal controls
headings.reviewNote: Covers eligible insurance investment securities, verification procedures, and director approval before withdrawal; does not imply unrestricted withdrawal.

entries.reviewSummary: Separate Codex editorial pass against the full archived version and notes: Read all custody and bookkeeping clauses, named fiduciary/insurance/bank capacities, demand certifications, regulatory limits, and clearing-corporation definition. Separate headings correctly distinguish state-treasurer collateral verification from insurance deposits and approval-controlled withdrawals. This is not independent legal review.
